title: Reliance Jio's Free-Data Gambit: The ₹1.5 Lakh Crore Bet That Re-priced Indian Telecom
context: In September 2016, Jio offered 4G data free for 6 months when rivals charged ₹250/GB. The move was widely called suicidal — instead it forced Vodafone-Idea consolidation, killed Airtel's margins for 3 years, and 5x'd India's data consumption per capita.
